blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The House of Representatives on Monday passed on final reading the P7.2-trillion budget bill for 2027, 62 days after receiving the executive’s spending plan from the Department of Budget and Management. The House approved House Bill No. 10858 after 281 lawmakers voted in favor and 13 against. One abstained. However, the manner in which lawmakers amended the measure drew backlash after they approved P116.32 billion in budget realignments that critics said could expand political patronage.
